children: According to Wallstreetcn, Yemen's Houthi spokesman Omar Bahiti said on September 20 that if Saudi Arabia continues military escalation against Yemen, the Houthi movement will take stronger retaliation, describing it as an approach of "escalation in response to escalation, blockade in response to blockade" and saying the move is an exercise of the right to self-defense.

title: Yemen's Houthi Spokesman Says Group Will Intensify Retaliation if Saudi Arabia Escalates Military Actions
